responsibility: Implements the main buffered file I/O subsystem for the pge-boot runtime, wrapping Unix file descriptors in FIO_File handles tracked through the Indexing module and maintaining per-file state such as usage mode, error status, filename metadata, absolute position, and optional read/write buffers. It owns file opening, closing, buffered and direct byte transfers, character and line operations, EOF/EOL handling, seek/position routines, and flushing of standard output/error, making it the foundational file layer below IO, SFIO, Output, and scanner-style consumers.
same_name_distinction: This source file implements the buffered file-handle runtime itself: it defines the FIO_FileDescriptor and buffer structures, manages the Indexing-backed handle table, creates the standard stream handles, and performs the actual read/write/seek/flush work. Unlike gcc/m2/pge-boot/GFIO.h, it is the operational backend rather than the public contract.
